nodes.description: Public game timer; set in the constructor from now + 10 minutes and mutated by the payable fallback.
Accumulated pot balance; credited in the fallback and paid out to the previous bidder.
Percentage divisor (10 = 10%) used to split msg.value into fee and bid value.
Hardcoded developer address that unconditionally receives the fee on every fallback call.
Address of the current leader; receives the pot via transfer when the timer expires and is overwritten by the fallback.
Payable constructor: initializes lastBidder to msg.sender, kBalance to msg.value, timeOut to now + 10 minutes and feeRate to 10.
Payable fallback that takes bids, skims a fee to TechnicalRise, pays the previous bidder when timeOut <= now, and extends the timer.
Caller-controlled address; assigned to lastBidder in both the constructor and the fallback.
now/block.timestamp drives the constructor deadline and the fallback's timeOut <= now payout condition and time extensions.
External call TechnicalRise.transfer(_fee) that executes unconditionally on every fallback invocation.
External call lastBidder.transfer(kBalance - _val) performed before kBalance/timeOut are updated, enabling re-entrant bidding.
Transient local holding msg.value / feeRate, the developer fee forwarded to TechnicalRise.
Transient local holding msg.value - _fee; used for the 9 finney threshold, the payout amount, kBalance and the time extension.
Unchecked pre-0.8 integer arithmetic: kBalance += _val, timeOut += 2 minutes and timeOut += (10 minutes * 9 finney) / _val.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns lastBidder = msg.sender, seeding the winner slot with caller-controlled input.
Fallback uses msg.sender (and msg.value) to register the new bidder and determine the previous bidder.
Constructor computes timeOut = now + 10 minutes directly from block.timestamp.
Fallback's payout branch (timeOut <= now) and every timeOut extension depend on the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
_fee is computed as msg.value / feeRate, reading the feeRate state variable.
The computed _fee amount is the value forwarded in TechnicalRise.transfer(_fee).
The hardcoded TechnicalRise address is the recipient of the fee transfer.
Payout amount kBalance - _val is derived from the caller-influenced local _val inside the external transfer.
kBalance state is read to size the payout before it is reassigned, so state is stale during the external call.
lastBidder is an externally owned address; transferring to it invokes its fallback code (callback into attacker contract).
The lastBidder.transfer external call can re-enter the payable fallback before kBalance and lastBidder are updated.
kBalance is updated (kBalance = _val) only after the external payout call, the classic state-after-call ordering flaw.
Fallback writes timeOut (+= 2 minutes, += (10 minutes * 9 finney) / _val, and timeOut = now).
Fallback writes kBalance (+= _val and kBalance = _val).
Fallback overwrites lastBidder = msg.sender for every accepted bid.
Fee transfer to TechnicalRise is executed unconditionally at the start of the fallback, before any bid validation.
When timeOut <= now the fallback path reaches the payout call to the previous bidder.
Fallback performs unchecked additions and a division on kBalance and timeOut.
_val is the divisor in (10 minutes * 9 finney) / _val and is added to kBalance without overflow checks.
kBalance participates in unchecked += _val arithmetic.
Constructor initializes the timeOut state variable.
Constructor initializes kBalance from msg.value.
Constructor initializes lastBidder.
Constructor initializes feeRate = 10.

normalization_plan.reason: _fee is a transient local derived from msg.value / feeRate whose only use is as the amount of the TechnicalRise.transfer external call, so it can be folded into the transfer unsafe_operation node.
_val is a transient local computed and fully consumed inside the payable fallback (threshold check, payout sizing, kBalance and timeOut updates), so it can be folded into the fallback function node.
